input: Checkout service latency spike, 5xx errors climbing since 14:02 UTC. Logs show 'TimeoutError: connection pool exhausted' on order-service. Deploy of order-service v2.14 went out at 13:55 UTC.
API gateway returning 502s across us-east and eu-west simultaneously. Started ~5 minutes after the scheduled TLS certificate rotation job finished. Upstream health checks are green.
Nightly batch-processor pod OOMKilled at 03:12 UTC. Grafana shows memory climbing steadily since the 'recommendations-v2' feature flag was enabled to 100% three days ago.
